test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A parallelogram has one parallel side length of 12 cm and perpendicular distance between its base and other parallel side is 8 cm. Its area is ________.
solution:
**Given:**

Length of one parallel side of the parallelogram = 12 cm

Perpendicular distance between the base and the other parallel side = 8 cm

**Formula Used:**

Area of a parallelogram = Base × Height

**Calculation:**

Base = 12 cm

Height = 8 cm

Area = Base × Height

⇒ Area = 12 cm × 8 cm

⇒ Area = 96 cm²

**The area of the parallelogram is 96 cm².**
